title: Remainders are values of f
caption: The remainder on dividing by (x − 1) is f(1) and by (x + 1) is f(−1). With a = 2 and b = 3 the curve passes through (1, 4) and (−1, −6), as the question requires.
alt: The graph of f(x) = 2x cubed plus 2x squared plus 3x minus 3 through the points (1, 4) and (−1, −6).
description: The remainder theorem says dividing by (x − 1) leaves f(1) and dividing by (x + 1) leaves f(−1).
The equations f(1) = 4 and f(−1) = −6 give a = 2 and b = 3.
The curve f(x) = 2x³ + 2x² + 3x − 3 passes through (1, 4) and (−1, −6).
